title: Kucht — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Kucht.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Professional Made Affordable." Kucht makes pro-style ranges with stainless steel construction and commercial aesthetics at entry-level prices. Their 36-inch gas range with convection undercuts every competitor. Available through independent dealers and online.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Extreme budget buyers who want pro-style look. Rental renovations. Independent dealer value option.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Kucht:

• Lowest-priced pro-style range on the market

• Stainless steel construction at budget pricing

• Convection oven standard even at entry price

• Growing dealer network and parts support

• Quick ship — usually in stock and ready
